title: The Power of Stories
excerpt: Stories shape how we understand ourselves and the world around us.
content:
The Power of Stories

Stories are one of the oldest forms of human connection. They preserve memory, pass on wisdom, and help us make sense of the world.

In a time of speed and noise, stories slow us down and make room for reflection. They remind us that every life carries complexity, tenderness, and meaning.

"A story is not only what happened; it is how it was carried forward in memory and meaning."
